rationale: Final sourced observation on the durability path (A6), recorded because the run's only confirmed violation lives there. recordInstanceMetadata (epaxos/epaxos.go:199-215) writes a fixed-length record whose fields are bal-slot, vbal, status, seq and deps, but the record carries no replica or instance identifier, and its length depends on r.N rather than on the instance's identity. recordCommands (epaxos/epaxos.go:217-227) writes each command back to back with no count and no instance header, and returns early for a nil command slice. Callers invoke the two independently (startPhase1, handlePreAccept, handleAccept, handleCommit), so the stable store is a stream of unaddressed fixed-length metadata records interleaved with unlabelled command payloads. Combined with the confirmed CLM-DURABLE-BAL violation, this means a restart reader would face three gaps before it could rebuild authority: the ballot is absent from the metadata slot, the metadata cannot be attributed to an instance, and the command payloads are not delimited per instance. I record this as a sourced unknown rather than a new candidate: no reader exists in the captured files, so there is no observable endpoint to check, and inventing a requirement for a format nobody reads would not be a grounded obligation. It refines the reason the durability path is unimplemented rather than contradicting any earlier statement.

feedback.answered: The durable path writes unaddressed data: metadata records of length 9+r.N*4 with no replica/instance identifier, and command payloads written back to back with no count or per-instance delimiter (epaxos/epaxos.go:199-227). So besides the confirmed loss of bal in the metadata slot, a restart would also have no way to attribute either record type to an instance in the captured format.
remaining: Whether any intended reader exists outside the captured files; none was found, so the missing addressing has no observable endpoint and is recorded as an unknown rather than a check.
Whether the confirmed CLM-DURABLE-BAL violation should be reported with the durability format gap as one finding or as separate items, which is the controller's attribution decision.
Whether a restarted replica is expected to read these records at all, which determines if any of the durability gaps matter operationally.
A1 fast-path qualification, A2 ballot/authority transitions and A4 membership remain unexercised by any check.
